summary: SECURITY VERIFICATION run for iteration 108. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter108_security_audit.py — 23/23 tests pass against public preview URL. All five SEC findings (SEC-001..SEC-005) are closed. Dev-OTP gate, password-strength policy (backend 422 + frontend meter), and regressions (GSTIN login, FSM key /ping) all verified.

sec_findings_status.SEC-001_store_pickup_verify_otp: CLOSED — (a) no cookies → 401 'Authentication required'; (b) old exploit payload {use_master_password:true, otp:'AddrikaAdmin@2026'} → 401; (c) retailer session on order belonging to another store → 403 'This order is assigned to a different store'; (d) retailer + correct customer OTP for own order → success:true, order.order_status='delivered', verification_method='customer_otp'; (e) 5 wrong OTPs then 6th → 429 'Too many incorrect OTP attempts'; (f) admin_override with retailer session → 403, admin_override with real admin session → success, verification_method='admin_override', no password required anywhere. Master-password code path fully removed.
sec_findings_status.SEC-002_public_retailer_pii: CLOSED — /api/retailers/by-location projects only PUBLIC_FIELDS whitelist (business_name, trade_name, name, retailer_id, id, address, registered_address, city, district, state, pincode, coordinates, is_addrika_verified_partner, retailer_label). Zero occurrences of email/phone/gst_number/spoc/admin_notes/legal_documents/password_hash/is_verified/kyc*/bank* in any returned record. Same whitelist applied in /api/retailers/public (map endpoint) — no leakage.
sec_findings_status.SEC-003_admin_pin_backdoor: CLOSED — /api/admin/forgot-pin/verify-otp with otp='addrika_admin_override' → 400 'Invalid OTP. N attempts remaining.' verify uses secrets.compare_digest against the emailed OTP only. /forgot-pin/reset without a verified token returns 4xx.
sec_findings_status.SEC-004_fail_closed_secrets: CLOSED — services/auth_service.py reads os.environ['JWT_SECRET_KEY'] and os.environ['ADMIN_DEFAULT_PIN']; backend booted cleanly (no KeyError in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). Full admin login flow (initiate → 2FA OTP from admin_2fa_tokens → verify-otp) works end-to-end. Wrong PIN rejected.
sec_findings_status.SEC-005_external_api: CLOSED — (a) Rate limit: primed api_key_rate_limits _id '<key_id>:<YYYYMMDDHHMM>' count=500 → next /api/external/v1/ping returned 429 'Rate limit exceeded'. Limiter now covers /ping too. (b) Scoping: created a new key with retailer_ids=['RTL_TEST_B2B'] via POST /api/admin/api-keys; that key's /retailers only listed RTL_TEST_B2B, /orders only returned that retailer's orders, cross-retailer order placement → 403/422. FSM unrestricted key (retailer_ids empty) remains fully functional. Key deleted afterwards. (c) SSRF guard rejects 127.0.0.1, localhost, 169.254.169.254, and 10.0.0.5 with 422 'private or reserved address'; https://example.com/hook accepted (deleted after).
